definitions.explanation: To pour a small amount of liquid, especially when serving drinks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目薬|めぐすり}→目薬：09714_megusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{注|さ}す。
⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{注|さ}して⟦{動|うご}き→動く：00904_ugoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Oil the machine to make it run better.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乾|かわ}いた→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧ので、⟦{目薬|めぐすり}→目薬：09714_megusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{注|さ}してから⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}けた→続ける：01231_tsuzukeru⟧。
examples.english: My eyes were dry, so I put in eye drops before continuing work.

notes:
{注|さ}す means to pour or apply liquid in small amounts.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)

KANJI DISTINCTION:
Several verbs are read さす but use different kanji:
- {注|さ}す: to pour, apply (liquid)
- {刺|さ}す: to stab, pierce
- {指|さ}す: to point at
- {挿|さ}す: to insert
- {差|さ}す: to hold up (umbrella), to shine (light)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {目薬|めぐすり}を{注|さ}す: to put in eye drops
- {油|あぶら}を{注|さ}す: to oil, lubricate
- お{酒|さけ}を{注|さ}す: to pour sake (for someone)
- {水|みず}を{注|さ}す: to add water, to throw cold water on (figuratively)

USAGE NOTE:
In the context of serving drinks, especially sake, {注|さ}す implies pouring for someone else as a gesture of hospitality.
